RELALATE METHODS: We propose HELIOS-LATE, an event-triggered graph scheduler. Its single contribution couples uncertainty-gated queue partitioning with a rollback-safe temporal consistency rule. These two coupled steps constitute one scheduling mechanism, not independent algorithms. Performance numbers are evaluation results, not separate contributions.
